caption: The drawing displays a detailed, technical illustration of an iron fence and gate in black ink on a beige background. On the left side, there is a vertical post measuring 65 inches in height and 10.5 inches in width, featuring ornate latticework and a decorative top. In the upper center-right, a gate is depicted with a width of 38 inches and a height of 49 inches; the gate has intricate Gothic-style pointed arches, quatrefoil motifs along the top, and elaborate scrollwork at the crown. The gate includes a visible lock mechanism on its left side. Below the gate, an elevation view of the entire fence and gate assembly shows two fence panels and the gate, with all components connected by posts and detailed with vertical bars and pointed finials; the full span of the fence is 169 inches. The phrase “IRON FENCE and GATE” is written to the right of the elevation view. The entire composition is rendered with fine, precise lines and includes measurement indicators for clarity.
title: Iron Gate and Fence
